name: pyxis
title: Pyxis Portfolio Challenge
description: Two pharma companies compete to build the most valuable drug-development portfolio over a fixed horizon.

episodeSteps.description: Framework step cap. The match ends earlier when the engine terminates both players (bankruptcy or horizon).

actTimeout.description: Seconds an agent has to return an action each step.

runTimeout.description: Seconds the whole episode may run (excludes the one-time reset warmup).

agentTimeout.description: Obsolete field kept for backwards compatibility, please use observation.remainingOverageTime.

seed.description: Optional episode seed. Kaggle controls this to run mirrored seed pairs externally. The interpreter reads it, clears it from configuration, and stores the resolved value on env.info['seed'] so it stays out of agent observations but is recorded in the replay.

reward.description: Match outcome for the agent: 1 = win, 0.5 = draw, 0 = loss (bankruptcy-aware, otherwise by net cash flow). An agent that submits an illegal action forfeits and its opponent is awarded the win. None on error/invalid/timeout.

obs.description: Flattened per-agent observation vector from the engine.

actionMask.description: Per-head action masks from the engine, one key per masked head (investments, ptrs_research, upgrade, demand_creation, brand_equity). Continuous bid heads (bd_bids, site_bid) are unmasked and absent.

agentIndex.description: Seat index of this agent (0 or 1).

kaggleEnvId.description: Internal id linking a built-in agent to the live engine instance. Ignored by isolated submissions.

cash.description: Agent cash at the current step (GBP).

enpv.description: Agent expected net present value at the current step (GBP).

initialized.description: Internal flag marking that the engine has been created for this episode.

action.description: Engine action dict, one entry per enabled action head. Missing or null heads are filled with their no-op, so an agent may send only the heads it uses (or {} to pass). An unknown head, or a choice that observation.actionMask forbids, forfeits the match. Heads are config-dependent; actionMask keys and the no-op shapes below reflect the live set.

investments.description: Per-asset investment level, length max_num_assets. 0 = no-op. Masked by actionMask.investments.

bd_bids.description: Per-slot business-development cash bids in GBP millions, length bd_max_slots. 0 = pass. Unmasked: an overbid is legal and can bankrupt the winner.

ptrs_research.description: PTRS readings to commission per slot (portfolio assets then BD slots). 0 = none. Masked by actionMask.ptrs_research.

upgrade.description: Clinical-site purchase: 0 = no-op, 1 = buy. Masked by actionMask.upgrade.

site_bid.description: Clinical-site auction cash bid in GBP millions, length 1. 0 = pass. Unmasked.

demand_creation.description: Per-indication demand-creation spend flag (0/1). Masked by actionMask.demand_creation.

brand_equity.description: Per-asset brand-equity spend flag (0/1). Masked by actionMask.brand_equity.
